purpose: The single declaration of every NIGHTWATCH_* environment variable the local Nightwatch surface reads, forwards or owns. hardening:check fails when a tracked production source reads a NIGHTWATCH_* variable that is absent here, and startup validation fails closed on a malformed declared value before any browser, subprocess or socket exists. Secret-bearing variables are rendered presence-only by the config view.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_AUTH_FILE
variables.purpose: Legacy alias for an authentication artefact path. Never inherited by a child; stripped by the quality gate and refused by capture.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_BUG_ATLAS_STATE_DIR
variables.purpose: Explicit bug-atlas snapshot state directory.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_ENV
variables.purpose: Fail-closed environment selection; one of local | dev | next. production is never loadable.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_GATE_ACTIVE
variables.purpose: Marks a quality-gate-owned child so evidence retention refuses to judge an in-progress gate run.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_GATE_RECEIPT_PATH
variables.purpose: Explicit quality-gate receipt destination; honoured only after full path validation.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_HEADED
variables.purpose: Browser headed/headless control: 1 headed, 0 headless.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_L6_LAUNCH
variables.purpose: Absolute launcher path inside the L6 containment envelope.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_L6_MODE
variables.purpose: L6 runtime classification string echoed by the capability descriptor.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_L6_PROXY_PORT
variables.purpose: Namespace-local L6 HTTP/upgrade proxy port created inside the containment namespace.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_L6_SOCKET
variables.purpose: AF_UNIX control-channel socket path for the L6 process/network containment capability.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_OPERATOR_SCOPE
variables.purpose: Operator scope class forwarded to local operator and agent children.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_OWNER_FINDINGS
variables.purpose: Legacy owner-findings path variable. Never inherited by a child; stripped by the quality gate.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_P1_SCOPE_CONFIG
variables.purpose: Path to the P1 passive-observation scope configuration record.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PHASE_10B_CI_RUN_ID

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PHASE_10B_DISPOSABLE_ROOT

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PHASE_10B_REAL
variables.purpose: Owner-manual Phase 10B real-observation mode marker.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRINT_ARGS
variables.purpose: JSON argv template consumed by the print reasoner.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRINT_CLI
variables.purpose: Path to the deterministic print reasoner used by the synthetic campaign lane.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRINT_DEBUG
variables.purpose: Optional debug dump path for the print reasoner.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRIVATE_STATE_DIR
variables.purpose: Explicit owner-private findings-store root outside the repository.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PROD_OBSERVE_CONFIG
variables.purpose: Path to the production observation configuration record; admitted only through the owner gate.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRODUCT
variables.purpose: Product fixture selector forwarded to a scenario run.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PRODUCTION_STATE_DIR
variables.purpose: Explicit production findings store root; structural only, never contacted by default.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PROXY_LEASE_OWNER_PID
variables.purpose: PID of the process that owns the current port lease.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PROXY_LEASE_PATH
variables.purpose: Port-lease file path published by the lease owner.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PROXY_LEASE_TOKEN
variables.purpose: Port-lease ownership token minted by the lease owner; presence-only in the config view.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_PROXY_PORT
variables.purpose: Loopback L5 proxy port published by the port lease owner and consumed by the proxy server and lease.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REASONER_CLI
variables.purpose: Absolute path to the owner-supplied reasoner executable. Validated pre-spawn as an absolute, existing, executable regular file resolved without shell interpretation; the resolved path and file digest are recorded in run evidence.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REASONER_MODEL
variables.purpose: Declared reasoner model label recorded in provenance; never inferred.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REASONER_PRINT
variables.purpose: Legacy print-reasoner selector forwarded to the agent surface.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REASONER_PROVIDER
variables.purpose: Declared reasoner provider label recorded in provenance; never inferred.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REASONER_SCRIPT
variables.purpose: Optional script argument passed to the configured reasoner executable.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REPOS_ROOT
variables.purpose: Root of the read-only sibling Alphaus repositories snapshot scope.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_REVIEW_STORE_DIR
variables.purpose: Explicit owner-private review-store root outside the repository.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_RUN_ID
variables.purpose: Deterministic run identifier override used for reproducible evidence paths.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_STORAGE_STATE
variables.purpose: Absolute path to an owner-captured Playwright storageState file. A path is a secret-bearing reference even though its bytes never enter this declaration.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_TOPOLOGY_EXPECTED_HOME
variables.purpose: Test-only fresh-HOME assertion for the CI-topology gate: names the synthetic HOME the gate created so the child can assert it is running under that absence. Never carries a secret.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_TRACE
variables.purpose: Trace control: on | off. Forwarded by launchers; traces are always disabled when authenticated state is loaded.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_TRACKED_REPOS
variables.purpose: Comma-separated relative repository paths to track; unset means every repository under the approved roots.

variables.name: NIGHTWATCH_UI_URL
variables.purpose: Optional absolute UI origin override. Must pass the selected environment allowlist and exact-origin validation before a browser context exists.
